text:
elaine_fin: FYI — Medlyx's April invoice for $78,900 failed at 03:12 PM PST. They attempted ACH via Plaid but microdeposit didn't appear; bank emailed saying "account type mismatch".

nora_billing: ugh. Are they blocked from retrying? do we have a fallback? @zoe_cs can you confirm if CS gave permission to share wire details? :thinking: 

zoe_cs: Confirmed — customer is fine with a one-off wire to unblock them ASAP. They asked to avoid wire fees if possible.

raj_payments: We can accept wire manually. Steps:
1) Send wire instructions (see below)
2) Mark invoice as "pending - wire" in Stripe
3) Once funds hit, apply payment and send receipt

Wire details (use exactly as customer reference: INVOICE-2983):
```
Bank: Union Pacific Bank (placeholder)
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: 3254391201
Routing (ACH/ABA): 111000025
Swift (for intl): UPBKUS44
Reference: INVOICE-2983 / Medlyx
```
Note: This is our standard receivable account. Finance will reconcile on receipt.

raj_payments: We should also open a temporary manual retry window in our billing system (48h) so they can attempt ACH re-init if they prefer. I'll schedule that.

mike_sales: Heads-up — this is the renewal account. CS wants update to ensure no feature access interruption. @nora_billing can we set a 72h grace before suspending any paid features? :pray:

nora_billing: We can set a 72h grace. I'll update the invoice terms and add a note: "Pending wire — do not suspend until 2026-05-05 11:59 UTC". We'll escalate if funds not received.

elaine_fin: @raj_payments please confirm if we can waive the $35 wire fee for this customer (they asked). Do we have precedent? :small_blue_diamond:

raj_payments: We can absorb the fee this time because it's a high-value renewal and it's CS-backed. I'll note the expense under "bad-debt/wire-fees". Logged.

billing-bot: Reminder set — follow up check in 48h for payment reconciliation.

zoe_cs: I'll send the customer the wire details now and confirm expected send date. Will paste the customer note to this thread after sending.

zoe_cs: (to customer) "Sending wire instructions below. Please include INVOICE-2983 in the reference. Reply when you've initiated the transfer so we can watch for it." :white_check_mark:

elaine_fin: Thanks everyone — set to monitor. If wire doesn't come in 48h, we'll open invoice dispute playbook and loop legal. :calendar:
